;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in North-West Pakistan]]
**The [[Afghanistan|Afghan]] [[Ministry of Defense (Afghanistan)|Ministry of Defense]] reports that Mullah [[Fazlullah (militant leader)|Fazlullah]], the [[emir]] of the [[Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan|Pakistani Taliban]], was killed in [[Kunar province]] by an U.S. [[drone strike]] two days prior on June 13. ;Business and economy
*[[2018 China–United States trade war]]
**The [[United States]] imposes a 25% tariff on goods imported from [[China]] worth [[USD|$]]50 billion, set to come into effect on July 6, and accuses [[Beijing]] of "intellectual copyright theft". [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-44498484 (BBC)] [https://www.aol.com/article/news/2018/06/15/trump-ignites-trade-war-with-china-officially-announces-tariffs-on-dollar50-billion-worth-of-chinese-goods/23459838/ (''Business Insider'' via AOL)]
**China responds with an additional tariff of 25% on $34 billion of U.S. goods, to come into effect on July 6, and tariffs on other goods to be announced at a later date. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-44498484 (BBC)]
*[[American Airlines]], after cancelling 275 of its regional carrier [[PSA Airlines]]'s scheduled flights on Thursday, cancels another 400 today at [[Charlotte Douglas International Airport]] because of a "technical issue." [http://www.foxnews.com/travel/2018/06/15/american-airlines-carrier-cancels-hundreds-flights-over-technical-issue-leaves-thousands-stranded.html (Fox News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Twelve people are killed and 30 injured after a bus crashed along a rural highway between [[Cochabamba]] and [[Potosi]], [[Bolivia]]. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-06/16/c_137257223.htm (Xinhua)]
*The [[Glasgow School of Art]] in [[Scotland]] suffers "extensive damage" after it catches on fire. No casualties are reported. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-scotland-glasgow-west-44504659 (BBC)]

;Health and environment 
*[[Kellogg's]] issues a voluntary recall of [[Honey Smacks]] amid fears of [[salmonella]] contamination, with affected areas including the [[United States]], [[Mexico]], [[Costa Rica]], and some parts of [[French Polynesia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-44491902 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*[[Mueller special counsel investigation#Paul Manafort and Rick Gates|Mueller special counsel investigation]]
**Former [[Donald Trump 2016 presidential campaign|Trump campaign]] chairman [[Paul Manafort]] has his [[bail]] revoked for allegedly tampering with witnesses, and is sent to jail to await his trial for foreign lobbying charges. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/06/15/politics/judge-sends-paul-manafort-to-jail-pending-trial/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/06/15/us/politics/manafort-bail-revoked-jail.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Kidnapping of Joshua Boyle and Caitlan Coleman]]
**Former [[Afghanistan]] hostage Joshua Boyle makes another appearance in court along with his lawyers to set a trial date. [https://ottawa.ctvnews.ca/mobile/boyle-back-in-court-today-1.3974648 (Ottawa CTV News)]
*A man who was seen barricading an armored vehicle and blocking traffic at the [[Mike O'Callaghan–Pat Tillman Memorial Bridge]] near the [[Hoover Dam]] is arrested. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/police-respond-to-reports-of-man-with-gun-at-hoover-dam-bridge/ (CBS News)]

;Sports
*[[Boris Becker]], who was once the highest ranked men's singles [[tennis]] player in the world, has claimed [[diplomatic immunity]] from a [[bankruptcy]] claim by private bankers [[Arbuthnot Latham]], based on his role as a sports [[attaché]] to the [[European Union]] from the [[Central African Republic]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-people-becker/boris-becker-claims-diplomatic-immunity-to-fend-off-bankruptcy-case-idUSKBN1JB107/ (Reuters)]
*[[2018 FIFA World Cup]]
**[[Cristiano Ronaldo]] scores a hat-trick achieving [[Portugal national football team|Portugal]]'s 3–3 draw against [[Spain national football team|Spain]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-soccer-worldcup-por-esp/hat-trick-hero-ronaldo-denies-spain-in-six-goal-thriller-idUSKBN1JB2PE (Reuters)]
